spec.instruction: Famous current cities across inhabited continents. Unambiguous names, stable current sovereign country. Six continent convention: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania. Exclude transcontinental cities, disputed territories, country or continent names copied in city names. No more than one third Europe; diverse countries.
